image_description: An outdoor scene featuring three people interacting with two large black plastic barrels on a paved surface. One barrel is upright, being worked on by a man standing over it; the other is lying on its side, held by a person kneeling in the foreground. A woman stands in the background observing. The setting appears to be a park or public area with grass and trees.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object classification as 'rain barrel' or 'industrial drum' and distinguish from generic trash cans.
To verify anatomical correctness of the three people, as AI often distorts hands and limbs in complex interaction scenes.
To check for fusion artifacts where hands touch the barrel rims and to ensure the barrels are solid, continuous objects.
To verify the spatial relationship between the people and the barrels, ensuring no floating elements or perspective errors.

focus_areas: Anatomical correctness of fingers and limbs
Barrel rim geometry and circular consistency
Shadow consistency under the barrels and people
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the hands of the man and the kneeling person. AI generators frequently struggle with hands gripping cylindrical objects. Check if the fingers merge into the plastic or have impossible joint angles. Also, verify if the 'lid' or fittings the man is handling look physically plausible or like melted gibberish.
